subject.title: Backup: add encrypted snapshot backup flow

question: Should OpenClaw core accept native folder-backed encrypted snapshots and backup.target/encryption config once the blockers are fixed, or keep encrypted/cloud backup workflows in ClawHub or plugins while core remains local export/verify?
rationale: The decision affects core config shape, destructive restore semantics, credential handling, and whether optional encrypted/cloud backup belongs in core or an extension surface.

options.title: Approve Scoped Native Snapshots
options.body: Accept the core direction only after the PR is rebased, hardened, and backed by fresh install plus upgrade and restore proof.

options.title: Keep Cloud Backup Plugin-Owned
options.body: Leave core at local archive export/verify and document ClawHub/plugin options for encrypted scheduled cloud backup.

options.title: Defer Until Restore Contract Lands
options.body: Pause this PR until the broader backup/restore umbrella defines config, credential, session, and rollback semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve Scoped Native Snapshots
recommendation.body: Accept the core direction only after the PR is rebased, hardened, and backed by fresh install plus upgrade and restore proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the best observed owner for the product-scope decision because recent backup docs/config routing and the native umbrella review point through that history.
